title: Kosi Bharal
meaning_en: The kosi (earthen altar) is filled — invocation to Chhathi Maiya on Kharna night.
lyricsSnippet: Kosi bharal Chhathi Maiya, geet gaila...

title: Uga Ho Suraj Dev
meaning_en: Rise, O Sun God — awaiting Usha Arghya at dawn.
lyricsSnippet: Uga ho Suraj Dev, arghya lebo...

title: Jai Chhathi Maiya
meaning_en: Praise to Chhathi Maiya, protector of children and family.
lyricsSnippet: Jai Jai Chhathi Maiya, sabke bhagya jagaila...

title: Kellwa Ke Paat Par
meaning_en: Offerings laid on banana leaves — the classic Sandhya Arghya song.
lyricsSnippet: Kellwa ke paat par, uge Suraj Mal...

title: Pahile Pahil Chhathi Maiya
meaning_en: First salutations to Chhathi Maiya — sung while filling the daura.
lyricsSnippet: Pahile pahil Chhathi Maiya ke, sat sat pranam...

title: Suraj Sange Chhathi
meaning_en: With the Sun, we worship Chhathi — evening vigil song.
lyricsSnippet: Suraj sange Chhathi Maiya, deep jalaila...
